title: Audit Tracking
description: Structured tracker for audit findings across a repository. Source of truth for finding status; companion .md files carry rich prose.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Bump on breaking changes to the finding shape.

findings.description: Flat list of audit findings across all audits in this repo.

id.description: Stable slug identifier. Format: '{audit}.{slug}' where slug is lowercase-kebab-case. Must be unique across the file.

audit.description: Which audit domain this finding belongs to. Must match the prefix in 'id'.

severity.description: Severity classification per the audit style guide.

status.description: Current status. 'needs_verification' = imported from .md but unable to confirm against code; review needed.

title.description: Short human description. Matches the .md heading.

description.description: Longer prose describing the finding. Multi-line via ordinary JSON string escapes (\n).

files.description: Repo-relative file paths this finding applies to.

opened_in.description: When this finding was first logged.

session.description: Session number from the session log, if applicable.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD when the finding was opened.

last_verified.description: YYYY-MM-DD the finding was last confirmed to still apply. Used to flag stale open findings.

ghe_issue.description: Umbrella audit GHE issue number (one per audit domain). Optional when finding is standalone.

resolved_in.description: Populated when status is 'resolved'. Null otherwise.

session.description: Session in which the fix landed.

pr.description: PR number that resolved this finding.

commit.description: Commit SHA, if no PR applies.

detected_by.description: How this resolution was recorded. 'audit_rerun' means the re-verification step inferred the fix (spot-check recommended).

follow_up_issue.description: GHE issue tracking broader work spawned by this finding (e.g. Option A refactor for C-2 is #203).

related_findings.description: IDs of related findings in other audits (same root cause viewed from different lenses).

notes.description: Freeform notes — resolution history, verification breadcrumbs, cross-references.

resolution_notes.description: Short prose describing how the resolution landed (e.g. which knobs flipped, which gaps remain).

accepted_rationale.description: Short prose citing why this finding is intentionally accepted (typically points at a project convention or design decision).
